$comment: What the SDK schema cannot say about the Swift side of each generated CmuxNextDaemon request type (swift_app/emit.py explains the rules). The files are generated at build time by the DaemonWireTypes plugin and never committed. A family is one Requests/<Family> folder; it moves here from hand-written Swift in one change.

feed-local-handoff-abort.name: FeedLocalHandoffAbortRequest
doc: `feed-local-handoff-abort {item}` (the verified app connection only): the
cloud owner answered `feed.adopt.cancel` with `cancelled: true`, so the
item is open here again. Never on a timeout or a lost reply.

feed-local-handoff-done.name: FeedLocalHandoffDoneRequest
doc: `feed-local-handoff-done {item, home}` (the verified app connection only):
the new owner committed the item; it becomes `moved`.

Layout.$comment: new-row stays hand-written in Layout/NewRowRequest.swift: it carries the shared SpawnOptions and moves with the Creation family.

doc: The neighbor a viewport column trades places with (`move-column`).
A direction from a pane: a split's side, a swap's or a focus move's neighbor.

move-column.name: MoveColumnRequest
doc: Moves the whole viewport column holding `pane` (every pane, split and row in it) one place left or
right (`column-move-v1`). The daemon refuses a column at the strip's edge or next to a docked column
(`column-move-edge`) and a docked column (`column-move-docked`).
Any pane of the column that moves.

set-column-dock.name: SetColumnDockRequest
doc: Pins the column holding `pane` to a viewport edge, or unpins it (`dock-columns-v1`). One docked
column per edge: the daemon unpins a column already on that edge, and refuses to leave no column
scrolling. `role` needs `dock-column-role-v1`; an older daemon ignores it. Build it from a
`DockSnapshot` with `init(pane:dock:pinned:transaction:)`.
`pinned-dock-v1`: true marks the column pinned (the Home dock); nil keeps what the column has (the
daemon never clears a pin).

set-row-heights.name: SetRowHeightsRequest
doc: `set-row-heights` (`rows-v1`): every row of one column at once. `fit` requires a sum of exactly 1000.

set-split-ratio.name: SetSplitRatioRequest
doc: Divider drag. Reuse one `transaction` per gesture so undo coalesces.

set-viewport-pane-width.name: SetColumnWidthRequest
doc: Column width drag (`viewport-column-resize-v1`). Reuse one `transaction` per gesture so undo coalesces.
The share of the viewport the column takes.

swap-pane.name: SwapPaneRequest
doc: Trades `pane` with its neighbor in `dir` or with the pane `target`; exactly one of them. Build it
from a `SwapTarget` with `init(pane:target:)`.

undo-layout.name: UndoLayoutRequest
doc: Undoes the last layout change of `pane`'s screen. An undo that closes panes first answers
`confirmation_required`; send it again with that `revision` and `confirmClose` to apply it.

move-profile.name: MoveProfileRequest
doc: Moves a profile to an insertion index (the `move-workspace` rule).

add-screens-to-screen-group.name: AddScreensToScreenGroupRequest
doc: Adds screens to a group. `index` is the position inside the group (default: the end).

remove-screens-from-screen-group.name: RemoveScreensFromScreenGroupRequest
doc: Removes screens from their groups; each lands right after its former group.

remote-host-status.name: RemoteHostStatusRequest
doc: `remote-host-status` (`remote-host-v1`, docs/cmux-remote.md): cmux Remote's state as the
daemon sees it (never starts the host).

move-tab-group-to-split.name: MoveTabGroupToSplitRequest
doc: Drops a whole group on a pane edge.

reopen-saved-tab-group.name: ReopenSavedTabGroupRequest
doc: Reopens a saved group into `pane`. A still-linked live group is returned
unchanged; otherwise running terminals reattach, others start in their
saved directory, and browsers reopen at their saved URL.

rename-surface.name: RenameTabRequest
doc: Renames a tab. Empty name clears it.

set-client-sizing.name: SetClientSizingRequest
doc: Claims (`enabled && exclusive`) or releases canonical geometry.

list-terminals.name: ListTerminalsRequest
doc: `list-terminals`: every terminal in the daemon's registry with its
workspace and, once ended, its exit record (cmux-tui terminal-host.md).

get-blob.name: GetBlobRequest
doc: `get-blob`: `blob` is `blob:sha256-<hex>` or an asset icon value.
One bookmark node as the daemon reports it (`bookmarks-v1`; plans/cmux-next/bookmarks.md section 2.1).
A folder's icon (`bookmark-icon-v1`): one emoji, an SF Symbol name or a
stored `image:`/`svg:sha256-<hex>` asset. Nil for none, for a URL
bookmark, and from a daemon without the capability.
`list-bookmarks` data.
`create-bookmark`, `update-bookmark` and `move-bookmark` data.
True when the daemon replayed an earlier write with the same mutation key.
`delete-bookmark` data.
A node of `import-bookmarks`: a folder with children or a URL.
`import-bookmarks` data.
`conversation-list` data.
`conversation-snapshot` data: the head and the newest messages, ascending.
The owner's stats of the thread roots in `messages` (`conversation-thread-v1`).
`conversation-history` data: one older page, ascending.
The owner's stats of the thread roots in `messages` (`conversation-thread-v1`).
`conversation-create` data.
True when the key was seen before and nothing changed.
`conversation-op` data: the committed revision and the change it made.
`conversation-thread` / `cloud-conversation-thread` data: the root, the
replies after `after_seq` (ascending), and the stats of the whole thread.
The owner's stats of one thread root, counted at read time (`conversation-thread-v1`).
The first three distinct reply authors, oldest reply first.
A committed message. `seq` is dense per conversation, starting at 1.
The root message of the thread this message replies in (`thread_root`).
Nil for a root, and for messages from before threads.
RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds.
A thread root's object (title, owner, resolution), conversation-thread-objects-v1.
One reaction on a message part.
A part of one message: the message's id and the part's index.
One message of a history import: its own id, client id, author, parts
(as the owner stores them) and time (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ`).
`conversation-import` data.
The seqs the imported messages got.
Messages the conversation already held.
`get-frontend-projection` data.
Null when the projection does not exist yet (revision 0).
One stored terminal command (`terminal-command-history-v1`). Ids and
times are decimal strings.

Tree.$comment: The daemon tree's snapshot types (list-workspaces). The schema's Tree objects are checked against the serializer by cmux-tui-core server/tree_schema_tests.rs. WorkspaceGroupSnapshot also reads list-personal's groups, whose room, mixed-order slot, icon and pin the schema declares as optional WorkspaceGroup fields.

doc: One tab of a pane as `list-workspaces` reports it (server.rs tab_json). Every field the GUI can live
without decodes leniently, so a newer daemon never breaks an older app.
The title's text as the daemon split it (wire `title_text`, D2): a terminal's without its leading status
glyphs, a page's as is. A daemon from before D2 sends only the raw `title`: it is the text then, glyphs included.
What a terminal title's leading glyph said (wire `title_activity`); nil for none, an unknown glyph and on older daemons.
Pinned tabs sort first in their pane (`tab-metadata-v1`).
The page a pinned browser tab was pinned on (Back to Pinned Page); nil when unpinned.
Presented directory: last OSC 7 report or launch dir (`tab-metadata-v1`).
Branch name, or the 7-char commit when `gitDetached` (`tab-metadata-v1`).
`"daemon"` (CDP), `"frontend"` (app-drawn), nil for PTYs (`frontend-browser-tabs-v1`).
`"webkit"` or `"cef"` for frontend browsers.

group.name: tabGroup
doc: Tab group membership (`tab-groups-v1`, wire `group`).
The terminal a `remote-terminal` tab references (`remote-terminal-tabs-v1`).
The conversation a `.conversation` tab shows.
The app a frontend app tab shows (`app-screens-v1`).
The workspace store's keep-layout record of a dead kept tab (`end-terminals-keep-layout-v1`).
Whether the terminal's shell runs (R41); nil for browsers, older daemons and unknown future states.
How a dead terminal ended (R41); nil while it runs, on older daemons and for unknown ends.
The record version of an unadoptable host (`terminalState == .unadoptable`).
One screen of a workspace as `list-workspaces` reports it (server.rs screen_json).
Empty unless horizontal viewport columns are active.
Pinned screens sort first.
The screen group this screen belongs to (`screen-groups-v1`).
Splits whose divider draws no line (`split-divider-visibility-v1`); they still drag.
The panes shown above the tiled layout, back to front (`floating-panes-v1`), as the daemon sent it; not
checked against the layout, the range or repeats. The daemon keeps each one a leaf of `layout`.
Width of the first column as a fraction of the viewport; nil means 1.0.
Optional palette token (`screen-metadata-v1`); frontends offer the nine group colors.
SF Symbol name or one emoji grapheme.
A split's viewport width (`Screen.viewport_splits[]`).
One horizontal scrolling column. Present when the screen has viewport splits (`viewport-splits-v1`).
Docked to a viewport edge; nil scrolls (`dock-columns-v1`; top and bottom also need `edge-docks-v1`).
The column's rows, top to bottom (`rows-v1`); empty for a column with one row. `layout` is then the
compat chain of these rows. A malformed `rows` keeps the column: the compat chain in `layout` still holds every pane.
Fraction of the frontend viewport width.
One row of a column (`rows-v1`, `Screen.columns[].rows[]`): a horizontal band of the column's vertical strip holding one split tree.
Permille of the column's viewport height, 100...1000. The sum per column is free: at most 1000 fills the column, more scrolls it.
The split tree inside the row.
One workspace as `list-workspaces` reports it (server.rs workspace_json). Every field the GUI can live
without decodes leniently, so a newer daemon never breaks an older app.
Durable identity. Nil only on servers without `workspace-registry-v1`.
Who supplied `name`; missing on older daemons and conservatively user-owned.
The workspace-local name revision; missing on older daemons and treated as zero.
Shared compatibility default, not user focus. Keep focus client-local.
Group membership (`workspace-groups-v1`); nil = ungrouped.
Palette token or `#RRGGBB[AA]` (`workspace-metadata-v1`).
SF Symbol name (`workspace-metadata-v1`).
Custom sidebar title that overrides `name` for display (`workspace-metadata-v1`).
Listed in the sidebar's Pinned section (`workspace-pin-v1`).
Marked unread by hand (`notification-mark-unread-v1`).
Tabs with an unread marker (`notification-ack-v1`); nil on older daemons.
Kept awake from a Mac (`workspace-keep-awake-v1`); false on older daemons.
`home` for the store's home workspace (`workspace-kind-v1`), `app` for an app workspace, else
`normal`; nil on older daemons.
The app of an app workspace (`kind` `app`, `app-screens-v1`): one screen with one app tab; nil
for every other workspace.
The daemon's recovery workspace (`workspace-recovered-v1`): its tabs are all terminals the daemon
recovered from orphaned hosts, so it is not a workspace the person made. Nil on daemons without it.
Contiguous screen group runs in screen order (`screen-groups-v1`).
One pane of a screen as `list-workspaces` reports it (server.rs pane_json). A pane the tree names but
state lacks arrives as `{"id", "dead": true}` and reads as an empty pane.
Shared compatibility default, not user focus.
Tab groups in this strip, in strip order (`tab-groups-v1`).
`list-workspaces` result (server.rs workspaces_json). The delta, paging and known-tree fields are for
other readers; this app asks for the whole tree.
Ordered workspace registry revision. Missing means 0 (old servers).
Ordered sidebar groups (`workspace-groups-v1`).
Session-wide saved tab groups (`saved-tab-groups-v1`). Not part of `list-workspaces`:
`DaemonConnection.snapshot()` fills it from `list-saved-tab-groups`.
Personal state (`profiles-v1`, home session only). Not part of `list-workspaces`:
`DaemonConnection.snapshot()` fills it from `list-personal`; nil on a daemon without it.
Sidebar section (`workspace-groups-v1`). Groups partition the one workspace order: a section lists its
workspaces in `workspaces` order.
Palette token or `#RRGGBB[AA]`.
Shared (not per-window) collapsed state.
Room of a personal group (`list-personal`); nil for shared groups.
The personal row index the group shows right before (`personal-mixed-order-v1`); nil after
every loose workspace.
The group's icon (`workspace-group-icon-v1`): one emoji or an SF Symbol name, the shared icon
string; nil is none.
Pinned (saved) group (`workspace-group-pin-v1`): kept as an empty saved group when its
workspaces close.
The group this one sits in, for a nested sidebar-document group (remote-groups-DESIGN.md R1); nil
at the top level and for every daemon (wire) group.
Group levels above it: 0 at the top level.
